idea-plugin.name: StarRocks Database Support
idea-plugin.description:
功能

StarRocks Database Support 为 DataGrip(及其他带 Database Tools 的 JetBrains IDE)提供独立的 StarRocks SQL 方言和完整的 StarRocks 数据库集成:

  • 在「新建数据源」对话框中注册独立的 StarRocks 数据源(STARROCKS,MySQL 家族),内置驱动配置。
  • StarRocks 专用 SQL 解析与语法高亮;关键字、数据类型和内置函数目录以 StarRocks 4.1 文档为基准。
  • 代码补全:StarRocks 关键字、数据类型、内置函数与专属语法片段;表、列等数据库对象补全由平台 SQL 系统提供。
  • StarRocks 方言 SQL 格式化,以及函数签名校验等代码检查。
  • 数据库对象模型:数据库、表、视图、物化视图;表/视图/物化视图支持原生 SHOW CREATE 定义视图(Go to DDL)。
  • 物化视图 DDL 打开后自动格式化,列清单每列一行。
  • SQL 中表、视图、物化视图的对象解析与 schema 限定搜索路径,消除错误的 "Unable to resolve" 提示。
  • 物化视图操作:右键执行 REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW、启用/停用(ACTIVE/INACTIVE);数据库树中显示物化视图状态。

Features

StarRocks Database Support provides a dedicated StarRocks SQL dialect and full StarRocks database integration for DataGrip (and other JetBrains IDEs with Database Tools):

  • Registers a dedicated StarRocks data source (STARROCKS, MySQL family) in the new data source dialog, with bundled driver configuration.
  • Dedicated StarRocks SQL parsing and syntax highlighting; keyword, data-type, and built-in function catalogs aligned with the StarRocks 4.1 documentation.
  • Code completion for StarRocks keywords, data types, built-in functions, and dedicated snippets; database-object completion is provided by the platform SQL system.
  • SQL formatting for the StarRocks dialect, plus inspections such as function signature validation.
  • Database object model: databases, tables, views, materialized views; native SHOW CREATE definition views (Go to DDL) for tables, views, and materialized views.
  • Materialized-view DDL is automatically reformatted when its definition tab opens, with one column per line.
  • Object resolution and schema-qualified search paths for tables, views, and materialized views in SQL, eliminating incorrect "Unable to resolve" highlights.
  • Materialized-view actions: run REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW and activate/deactivate (ACTIVE/INACTIVE) from the context menu; MV status is shown in the database tree.
